title: Civil Engineer
salaryText: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience
summary: Design, construction and commissioning of major water infrastructure: water supply, wastewater, drainage, pipelines and pumping stations. Based in Ireland, with openings in other European countries.
about: Level: Civil / Project Engineer, with career progression. Reports to a Senior or Lead Engineer or Engineering Manager.

Career path: Civil Engineer, then Senior Civil Engineer, Lead Engineer, Engineering Manager and Engineering Director. Development includes digital technologies, sustainability, leadership training and support towards chartership.

Selection includes technical interviews, practical engineering assessments and professional references. Direct water infrastructure experience is desirable but not essential where sound fundamentals and transferable experience are shown.
responsibilities: Support engineering design, calculations, technical drawings, site investigations and construction delivery
Contribute to water supply, wastewater, drainage, pipeline and pumping station projects
Investigate engineering problems, assess alternatives, manage risks and verify solutions
Work with civil, hydraulic, mechanical, electrical and environmental engineers
Support inspections, quality assurance, testing, commissioning and project handover
Apply CAD, BIM and digital engineering tools, and build skills in GIS, digital twins and AI-assisted engineering
Support project planning, contractor coordination, cost control and technical reporting
requirements: Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or a closely related engineering discipline
Relevant civil engineering, construction or infrastructure experience
Sound knowledge of engineering mathematics, technical drawings, construction materials and engineering principles
Able to analyse problems, weigh evidence and recommend practical solutions
Competent in relevant engineering software
Strong communication and teamwork, and a commitment to professional development
International qualifications and transferable experience are welcome, subject to verification
desirable: Experience in water, utilities, energy, transport or major infrastructure projects
Postgraduate engineering or construction management qualification
AutoCAD, Civil 3D, Revit, BIM, GIS or hydraulic modelling
Familiarity with sustainability, digital construction or infrastructure commissioning
Progress towards professional registration or chartership

title: Electrical Engineer
salaryText: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience
summary: Design, installation and commissioning of electrical systems for water and wastewater facilities, energy systems and major construction. Based in Ireland, with openings in other European countries.
about: Level: Electrical / Project Engineer, with career progression. Reports to a Senior or Lead Electrical Engineer or Engineering Manager.
Career path: Electrical Engineer, then Senior Electrical Engineer, Lead Electrical Engineer, Engineering Manager and Engineering Director.

Selection includes technical interviews, practical engineering assessments and professional references. Direct water infrastructure experience is desirable but not essential where strong electrical fundamentals and transferable experience are shown.
responsibilities: Design and support LV/MV electrical distribution, substations, transformers, switchgear and associated infrastructure
Carry out load-flow analysis, electrical calculations, equipment selection and technical verification
Support electrical systems for pumping stations, water treatment facilities and critical infrastructure
Take part in inspections, fault investigations, testing, commissioning and handover
Work with motors, variable-speed drives, instrumentation, automation and SCADA systems
Promote energy efficiency, renewable integration and resilient power systems
Support project planning, contractor coordination, technical reporting and cost control
requirements: Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, electrical and electronic engineering or a closely related discipline
Relevant experience in electrical design, installation, maintenance, commissioning or infrastructure engineering
Sound understanding of electrical principles, calculations, distribution systems and safety
Able to read single-line diagrams, specifications and technical drawings
Competent in relevant engineering software
Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills
International qualifications and transferable experience are welcome, subject to verification
desirable: Experience with 11kV/33kV networks, substations, transformers, switchgear, RMUs or pumping installations
Experience in water, utilities, energy, industrial facilities, data centres or major construction
Knowledge of PLCs, SCADA, instrumentation, automation and variable-speed drives
AutoCAD, ETAP, PowerFactory, BIM, AI or data analytics
Postgraduate qualification, or progress towards professional registration or chartership

title: Civil BIM / Digital Engineer
salaryText: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience
summary: BIM modelling and coordination for major water infrastructure projects, using Revit, Civil 3D and Navisworks. Based in Ireland, with potential UK and Northern European opportunities.
about: Level: Civil BIM / Digital Engineer, with career progression. Reports to a Senior Civil Engineer or Digital Engineering Lead.
Career path: Civil BIM / Digital Engineer, then Senior Digital Engineer, Digital Engineering Lead, Digital Engineering Manager and Engineering Director.
Selection includes technical interviews, practical BIM and engineering assessments and professional references.
responsibilities: Develop and coordinate civil engineering models, drawings and technical documentation
Support water, wastewater, drainage, pipeline and pumping station infrastructure
Carry out BIM coordination, clash detection, constructability reviews and technical verification
Make sure digital models reflect approved designs and site requirements
Apply Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, AutoCAD, GIS and related tools
Support ISO 19650 information management, open BIM and common data environments
Support project coordination, technical reporting, quality assurance and programme delivery
requirements: Bachelor's degree in civil engineering or a closely related discipline, with demonstrated civil engineering competence
Relevant BIM, digital engineering, civil construction or infrastructure experience
Sound understanding of civil engineering principles, technical drawings and construction methods
Competent in BIM/CAD software and digital project documentation
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and teamwork skills
International qualifications and transferable experience are welcome, subject to verification
desirable: Postgraduate qualification in civil engineering, BIM, digital construction or sustainable engineering
Experience in water, utilities, transport, energy or major infrastructure
Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Solibri, Autodesk Construction Cloud, GIS or Dynamo
Familiarity with ISO 19650, IFC/open BIM, digital twins, AI or lifecycle assessment
Progress towards professional registration or chartership

title: Senior Construction / Project Manager
salaryText: Competitive senior management package, based on experience and responsibility
summary: Lead the planning, construction and commissioning of major water and civil infrastructure projects, with progression towards Project Director and Programme Director. Based in Ireland, with openings in other European countries.
about: Level: Senior Construction / Project Manager. Reports to the Programme Director or Engineering Director.
Career path: Senior Construction / Project Manager, then Project Director, Programme Director, Construction Director and executive leadership.
Selection includes technical and commercial interviews, review of major project achievements, leadership assessment and professional references.
responsibilities: Lead complex infrastructure projects from mobilisation through commissioning and handover
Manage multidisciplinary engineers, contractors, consultants and subcontractors
Oversee programmes, budgets, resources, construction methods and quality
Manage procurement, contracts, forecasts, variations and claims, applying NEC/FIDIC principles where relevant
Maintain project governance, risk management, reporting and accountability
Manage client relationships, public authorities and senior stakeholders
Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental and regulatory requirements
Apply BIM, digital project controls and data analytics, and promote sustainable construction
requirements: Bachelor's degree in civil engineering, construction management, engineering or a closely related discipline
Substantial senior-level experience delivering major construction or infrastructure projects
Proven responsibility for project budgets, programmes, contracts and multidisciplinary teams
Strong construction, commercial, contractual and risk management expertise
Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, negotiation and communication skills
Commitment to safety, quality, professional ethics and regulatory compliance
International qualifications and transferable experience are welcome, subject to verification
desirable: Master's degree in construction project management, engineering management or a relevant discipline
PMP, PRINCE2, Chartered Engineer, Chartered Construction Manager or equivalent
Experience in water, utilities, energy, data centres or major civil infrastructure
Knowledge of NEC/FIDIC contracts, Primavera P6, BIM and digital project controls
International experience across Ireland, the UK, Europe or other major construction markets

title: Lead / Principal Software Engineer (AI and Robotics)
salaryText: Competitive senior engineering package, based on qualifications and experience
summary: Lead the design and deployment of software, AI and robotic systems for advanced manufacturing, data centres, construction technology and critical infrastructure. Based in Ireland, with openings in other European countries.
about: Level: Lead / Principal Software Engineer. Reports to the Engineering Director or Chief Technology Officer.
Career path: Lead Software Engineer, then Principal Engineer or Software Architect, Head of Software Engineering, Engineering Director and Chief Technology Officer.

Selection includes qualification checks, technical interviews, software architecture assessments, practical AI and robotics challenges, leadership evaluation and references. Hands-on robotics expertise is essential for robotics-intensive appointments.
responsibilities: Lead multidisciplinary engineering teams delivering complex, mission-critical software
Design scalable, secure, high-performance architectures and direct development, testing, deployment and technical governance
Develop and deploy AI, machine learning, deep learning and computer vision systems
Lead robotic automation and autonomous systems, integrating AI with sensors, perception, motion planning and control
Integrate software with IoT, PLCs, SCADA, digital twins and industrial automation
Improve data centre reliability, cooling efficiency, energy management and operational resilience
Ensure rigorous AI validation, functional safety, cybersecurity and responsible deployment
Mentor engineers and take accountability for technical decisions
requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering or a closely related discipline
Substantial software engineering experience, including leadership of highly technical teams
Advanced programming expertise in Python, C++, Java, C# or equivalent
Strong knowledge of software architecture, algorithms, distributed systems and cloud computing
Proven experience developing and deploying AI, machine learning or robotics systems in production
Excellent mathematical, analytical, problem-solving and technical leadership skills
International qualifications and equivalent advanced experience are welcome, subject to verification
desirable: Master's degree or PhD in AI, machine learning, robotics, computer science or computational engineering
Deep learning, computer vision, reinforcement learning, generative AI or autonomous systems
ROS 2, SLAM, robotic perception, motion planning or control systems
PyTorch, TensorFlow, MLOps and AI model validation
Industrial automation, digital twins, embedded systems or cyber-physical technologies
Experience in advanced manufacturing, data centres, energy or major construction
Knowledge of cybersecurity, functional safety and European AI regulations
Research publications, patents or commercial technology innovations

title: Electrician
summary: Electrician roles on construction, logistics, infrastructure and warehouse sites under the Germany Skilled Worker Visa programme. Contract length depends on experience.
about: Contract: 2 to 3 years, depending on experience. Work sites: construction and logistics, infrastructure and warehouses.

The estimated 4 to 6 months covers interviews, document verification, paperwork and the visa application. This is an indicative timeframe, not a guarantee. The German authorities decide on each visa, and you may be asked for further documents during the process.

Eligible skilled workers may later apply for family reunification for a spouse and children under 18, subject to German immigration rules. Employers often suggest settling into the job first, typically for around six months.
requirements: At least 1 year of paid work experience
Completed vocational training, a trade diploma, or an ITI or degree in electrical engineering, electrical installation or a related field
Foreign certificates usually need official recognition in Germany (Anerkennung)
German language at A1 level
German translations of your documents

requirements: Bachelor's degree or a state-recognised physiotherapy qualification, roughly equivalent to the 4,500 hours of German training

German language at B1 level
Police clearance certificate
German translations of your documents
